caveats: Codex JSONL does not expose per-model-turn usage; Claude's 160-turn/$12 caps cannot be enforced by this adapter.
Cost is standard list-price equivalent, not a subscription charge. Native input tokens include cache reads/writes.
Personal user configuration, web search and multi-agent tools are disabled; workspace-write sandbox, fresh clone per run.

metric_definitions.input_tokens: Total input including cached input; cumulative across solver requests.
metric_definitions.cost_usd: Base standard list-price estimate for solver only; not an invoice.
metric_definitions.wall_seconds: Solver CLI wall time; copying and hidden grading excluded.
metric_definitions.num_turns: Unavailable for Codex native exec; null, not 1.

comparison_scope: Same tasks/repeats/effort labels; Claude comparisons include different runtime, tooling, limits and dates.
